description: This Java class implements a hash-based partitioning service for message queues within the Thingsboard platform, managing queue topics, partitions, and service responsibilities, including dynamic rebalancing and event publishing.

classes.name: HashPartitionService.QueueConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for queue properties, such as duplicate message settings.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Creates a HashFunction instance based on the provided hash function name.

methods.name: buildTopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Builds a TopicPartitionInfo object for a given queue key and partition.

methods.name: getQueueRoutingInfos
methods.description: Retrieves routing information for queues, with retries if necessary.

methods.name: isTransport
methods.description: Checks if the service type is 'tb-transport'.

methods.name: getRoutingInfo
methods.description: Gets routing info for a tenant, fetching from cache or service.

methods.name: getIsolatedOrSystemTenantId
methods.description: Returns tenant ID based on isolation status.

methods.name: logServiceInfo
methods.description: Logs information about a service instance.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Adds a service node to internal mappings based on its type and profiles.

methods.name: resolveByPartitionIdx
methods.description: Resolves responsible services for a given partition index.

methods.name: toServiceIds
methods.description: Converts a collection of ServiceInfo objects to a list of service IDs.
